datasets.name: 9424f968
queryLines:
SELECT (SUM(gmv_item) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)) AS AOV
FROM olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items

datasets.name: 656b1d41
queryLines:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(is_on_time AS INT)), 4) AS pct_on_time
FROM olist_prod.gold.dim_order
WHERE is_delivered = TRUE

datasets.name: 729e3739
queryLines:
SELECT
    t.year_month,
    t.month,
    t.month_name,
    SUM(s.gmv_item) AS monthly_gmv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS monthly_orders
FROM olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items s
JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_date t
    ON s.purchase_date_sk = t.date_sk
GROUP BY t.year_month, t.month, t.month_name
ORDER BY t.year_month

datasets.name: agg_gmv_by_category
queryLines:
SELECT
  p.product_category_name_english,
  ROUND(SUM(f.gmv_item), 2) AS category_gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS category_orders
FROM
  olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items f
    JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_product p
      ON f.product_sk = p.product_sk
GROUP BY
  p.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY
  category_gmv DESC
  LIMIT 10

datasets.name: 745c0ea5
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT('BR-', c.customer_state) AS state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS num_orders,
  SUM(oi.gmv_item) AS total_gmv
FROM olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items oi
JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_customer c ON oi.customer_sk = c.customer_sk
GROUP BY CONCAT('BR-', c.customer_state)

datasets.name: 321e689b
queryLines:

  o.delivery_days,
  r.review_score,
  r.order_id
FROM
  olist_prod.gold.fact_reviews r
    JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_order o
      ON r.order_sk = o.order_sk

datasets.name: pareto_seller_gmv
queryLines:
WITH seller_gmv AS (
  SELECT
    f.seller_id,
    SUM(f.gmv_item) AS seller_total_gmv
  FROM
    olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items f
  GROUP BY
    f.seller_id
),
total AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(seller_total_gmv) AS grand_total_gmv
  FROM
    seller_gmv
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    t.grand_total_gmv,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.seller_total_gmv DESC) AS rank,
    COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_sellers,
    SUM(s.seller_total_gmv) OVER (
        ORDER BY s.seller_total_gmv DESC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
      ) AS cumulative_gmv
  FROM
    seller_gmv s CROSS JOIN total t
),
bucketed AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN rank <= CEIL(total_sellers * 0.01) THEN '① Top 1%'
      WHEN rank <= CEIL(total_sellers * 0.05) THEN '② Top 1–5%'
      WHEN rank <= CEIL(total_sellers * 0.10) THEN '③ Top 5–10%'
      WHEN rank <= CEIL(total_sellers * 0.20) THEN '④ Top 10–20%'
      WHEN rank <= CEIL(total_sellers * 0.50) THEN '⑤ Top 20–50%'
      ELSE '⑥ Bottom 50%'
    END AS seller_bucket,
    CASE
      WHEN rank <= CEIL(total_sellers * 0.01) THEN 1
      WHEN rank <= CEIL(total_sellers * 0.05) THEN 2
      WHEN rank <= CEIL(total_sellers * 0.10) THEN 3
      WHEN rank <= CEIL(total_sellers * 0.20) THEN 4
      WHEN rank <= CEIL(total_sellers * 0.50) THEN 5
      ELSE 6
    END AS bucket_order,
    seller_total_gmv,
    grand_total_gmv,
    cumulative_gmv
  FROM
    ranked
)
SELECT
  seller_bucket,
  bucket_order,
  COUNT(*) AS seller_count,
  ROUND(SUM(seller_total_gmv), 2) AS bucket_gmv,
  ROUND(SUM(seller_total_gmv) / MAX(grand_total_gmv) * 100, 2) AS pct_of_gmv,
  ROUND(MAX(cumulative_gmv) / MAX(grand_total_gmv) * 100, 2) AS cumulative_pct_gmv
FROM
  bucketed
GROUP BY
  seller_bucket,
  bucket_order
ORDER BY
  bucket_order

datasets.name: agg_customer_density
queryLines:
SELECT
  CONCAT('BR-', c.customer_state) AS state,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS num_orders,
  SUM(oi.gmv_item) AS total_gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS num_unique_customers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT oi.seller_id) AS num_unique_sellers
FROM
  olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items oi
    JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_customer c
      ON oi.customer_sk = c.customer_sk
GROUP BY
  CONCAT('BR-', c.customer_state)

datasets.name: top10_sellers_gmv
queryLines:
SELECT
  s.seller_id,
  s.seller_city,
  s.seller_state,
  SUM(f.gmv_item) AS total_gmv,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS num_orders
FROM
  olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items f
    JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_seller s
      ON f.seller_sk = s.seller_sk
GROUP BY
  s.seller_id,
  s.seller_city,
  s.seller_state
ORDER BY
  total_gmv DESC
LIMIT 10

datasets.name: monthly_new_cust_sellers
queryLines:
WITH first_customer AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_unique_id,
    MIN(d.year_month) AS first_month
  FROM
    olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items f
      JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_customer c
        ON f.customer_sk = c.customer_sk
      JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_date d
        ON f.purchase_date_sk = d.date_sk
  GROUP BY
    c.customer_unique_id
),
first_seller AS (
  SELECT
    f.seller_id,
    MIN(d.year_month) AS first_month
  FROM
    olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items f
      JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_date d
        ON f.purchase_date_sk = d.date_sk
  GROUP BY
    f.seller_id
),
new_customers AS (
  SELECT
    first_month AS year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS new_customers
  FROM
    first_customer
  GROUP BY
    first_month
),
new_sellers AS (
  SELECT
    first_month AS year_month,
    COUNT(*) AS new_sellers
  FROM
    first_seller
  GROUP BY
    first_month
)
SELECT
  TO_DATE(CONCAT(COALESCE(c.year_month, s.year_month), '-01')) AS month_date,
  COALESCE(c.year_month, s.year_month) AS year_month,
  COALESCE(c.new_customers, 0) AS new_customers,
  COALESCE(s.new_sellers, 0) AS new_sellers
FROM
  new_customers c
    FULL OUTER JOIN new_sellers s
      ON c.year_month = s.year_month
ORDER BY
  month_date

datasets.name: orders_gmv_by_dow
queryLines:
SELECT
  d.day_of_week,
  d.day_name,
  d.day_short,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id) AS num_orders,
  SUM(f.gmv_item) AS total_gmv
FROM
  olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items f
    JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_date d
      ON f.purchase_date_sk = d.date_sk
GROUP BY
  d.day_of_week,
  d.day_name,
  d.day_short
ORDER BY
  d.day_of_week

SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(f.gmv_item) DESC) AS rank,
    s.seller_id AS SELLER_ID,
    s.seller_city AS SELLER_CITY,
    s.seller_state AS SELLER_STATE,
    ROUND(SUM(f.gmv_item),2)              AS TOTAL_GMV,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.order_id)   AS TOTAL_ORDERS,
    ROUND(AVG(r.review_score),2)          AS AVG_REVIEW_SCORE
    -- ROUND(100.0 * SUM(f.gmv_item) / SUM(SUM(f.gmv_item)) OVER (), 2) AS gmv_share_pct
FROM olist_prod.gold.fact_order_items f
JOIN olist_prod.gold.dim_seller s
    ON f.seller_sk = s.seller_sk
LEFT JOIN olist_prod.gold.fact_reviews r
    ON f.order_sk = r.order_sk
GROUP BY s.seller_id, s.seller_city, s.seller_state
ORDER BY total_gmv DESC, total_orders DESC
LIMIT 31
